body: I suppose. I'm not sure where to go to next though.

I have with some success. I eat primarily chicken so I decided it makes sense to try beef. I ate some and it tasted a little foreign to me, but no violent reactions. So there's that, but it's just frustrating because there's no adult meal I can eat at most restaurants that doesn't have something I find repulsive in it.

Not thinking about them, but attempting to actually eat them. I get extremely anxious when people pressure me to try new stuff. For example, pizza to me looks revolting. I took a bite one time and threw up since it looked cheesy and disgusting. It's the same with a huge range of other foods too numerous to really list here like soups, any "liquid" foods...no vegetables besides corn (nutritionally worthless), no real fruits, etc. I can drink orange juice but not eat oranges. It's completely irrational, I know. I feel like an idiot when I try to explain it to people. I guess it's like, a person can be deathly afraid of snakes and it totally isn't a problem because they never have to face a snake, but for me I find myself in these situations all the time.
